# SYNESIS_E026 — Error

## Description

Decimal value `value` in `field_name` — the field only accepts integers [1..1].

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The value `value` has decimals, but the field `field_name`
  was declared with an integer range (`FORMAT [1..1]`).
  This field only accepts integers.
  Use an integer within the range, or ask the project coordinator
  to adjust FORMAT to accept decimals (e.g. `FORMAT [1.5..1.5]`).
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DecimalInIntegerScale**: `field_name`, `value`, `min_val`, `max_val`
